detectionPrecedence: MAPS supply source or a non-search placement
bid-strategy or campaign-name hints retained as evidence without establishing strategy
non-search-or-unsupported when evidence is missing, mixed, or conflicting

manual-search-results.applicability: App Store search-results campaigns using manual CPT bidding
invariants: theme grouping may be campaigns or ad groups
campaign names do not establish strategy alone

maximize-conversions.applicability: Eligible post-launch App Store search-results campaigns using MAX_CONVERSIONS
invariants: target CPA retains source and approval state
daily budget is checked against approximate five-conversion capacity
learning guidance is at least two weeks
checks: daily budget supports approximately five conversions
maximize-conversions.forbiddenAssumption: Separate discovery ad groups are not required by this strategy.

non-search-or-unsupported.applicability: Non-search placements, MAPS supply, mixed strategies, or insufficient evidence
non-search-or-unsupported.forbiddenAssumption: Search-results keyword structure checks do not apply automatically.

nonApplicable: Never apply manual theme failures to Maximize Conversions.
Never apply App Store search-results keyword checks to Search tab, Today tab, product pages, or MAPS.
Never convert a campaign-name hint into high-confidence strategy detection.
